build_mask2former_model: build a Mask2Former panoptic segmentation model with ResNet50 backbone and 133 classes
configure_data_preprocessor: configure DetDataPreprocessor with batch augmentation for 1024x1024 image padding and segmentation masking
setup_training_pipeline: setup a training pipeline with random flip, large scale jittering, and absolute random cropping
configure_optimizer: configure AdamW optimizer with backbone learning rate multiplier and gradient clipping
run_panoptic_evaluation: run panoptic evaluation on COCO with CocoPanopticMetric and CocoMetric for bbox and segmentation
